verdict.sentence: Algae likely, 56°F water, calm this morning.

level.note: No gauge on this lake. A level trend from the shoreline starts after the next clear days.

clarity.label: Algae likely
clarity.note: Last clear view: over a week ago.

ice.caveat: Ice thickness is an estimate from air temperature, not a measurement. Check the ice yourself before going on it.
